The owner plans to price them so that selling only 120 speakers would guarantee a 40% profit on the total investment. However, a local event leads to the sale of 135 speakers. If the remaining speakers have no resale value, calculate the store's actual profit percentage on the total investment.

questions.question: The set of real numbers includes which of the following?
questions.questionHtml: The set of real numbers includes which of the following?
questions.solution:
Real numbers consist of all rational numbers (e.g., 1 ÷ 2, −3, 0.75).

Real numbers also include irrational numbers (e.g., √2, π).

⇒ The set of real numbers contains both rational and irrational numbers.

questions.question: Dhanush crosses a road 100 metres wide in 50 seconds. His speed in km/hr is:
questions.questionHtml: Dhanush crosses a road 100 metres wide in 50 seconds. His speed in km/hr is:
questions.solution:
Let Speed (m/s) = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Speed (m/s) = 100 ÷ 50 = 2 m/s

⇒ Speed (km/h) = 2 × 18 ÷ 5 = 7.2 km/h

questions.question: A sphere is inscribed inside a cube. The volume of the cube is 1728 cm³. What is the total surface area of the sphere?
questions.questionHtml: A sphere is inscribed inside a cube. The volume of the cube is 1728 cm³. What is the total surface area of the sphere?
questions.solution:
Volume of cube ⇒ a3 = 1728

⇒ a = ∛1728 = 12 cm

Radius of sphere ⇒ r = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

Surface area ⇒ 4 × π × r2 = 4 × π × 62 = 144π cm2

questions.question: A large wooden box, open at the top, needs to be lined with fabric on its inner floor and inner four side walls. The inner dimensions of the box are 2.5 m length, 1.8 m wide, and 1.2 m high. If the fabric comes in square pieces of side 50 cm, and 15% extra fabric is needed for cuts and overlaps, how many approximate fabric pieces should be purchased?
questions.questionHtml: A large wooden box, open at the top, needs to be lined with fabric on its inner floor and inner four side walls. The inner dimensions of the box are 2.5 m length, 1.8 m wide, and 1.2 m high. If the fabric comes in square pieces of side 50 cm, and 15% extra fabric is needed for cuts and overlaps, how many approximate fabric pieces should be purchased?
questions.solution:
⇒ Area of floor = 2.5 × 1.8 = 4.5 m2

⇒ Area of two longer walls = 2 × (2.5 × 1.2) = 6 m2

⇒ Area of two shorter walls = 2 × (1.8 × 1.2) = 4.32 m2

⇒ Total lining area = 4.5 + 6 + 4.32 = 14.82 m2

⇒ Area including extra = 14.82 × 1.15 = 17.043 m2

⇒ Area of one fabric piece = 0.5 × 0.5 = 0.25 m2

⇒ Number of pieces = 17.043 ÷ 0.25 = 68.172

questions.question: A square of side 10 cm has a smaller square (of side 4 cm) removed from one side. What is the ratio of the remaining area to the original?
questions.questionHtml: A square of side 10 cm has a smaller square (of side 4 cm) removed from one side. What is the ratio of the remaining area to the original?
questions.solution:
⇒ Original area = 10 × 10 = 100

⇒ Removed area = 4 × 4 = 16

⇒ Remaining area = 100 − 16 = 84

⇒ Ratio = 84 ÷ 100 = 21 : 25

questions.question: A regular hexagon has a perimeter of 72 cm. What is its area?
questions.questionHtml: A regular hexagon has a perimeter of 72 cm. What is its area?
questions.solution:
⇒ Side length = 72 ÷ 6

⇒ Side length = 12 cm

⇒ Area = (3√3 ÷ 2) × 122

⇒ Area = (3√3 ÷ 2) × 144

⇒ Area = 374.12 cm²

questions.question: Out of her total monthly income, a woman spends 60% on household expenses and 15% on savings. The remaining is spent on other items. What percentage of her income is spent on these other items?
questions.questionHtml: Out of her total monthly income, a woman spends 60% on household expenses and 15% on savings. The remaining is spent on other items. What percentage of her income is spent on these other items?
questions.solution:
⇒ Total percentage spent = 60% + 15% = 75%

⇒ Percentage spent on other items = 100% − 75% = 25%

questions.question: A triangular prism has a base with area 45 cm² and height 14 cm. If 10% of the prism is hollowed out for wiring, what is the volume of the solid part?
questions.questionHtml: A triangular prism has a base with area 45 cm² and height 14 cm. If 10% of the prism is hollowed out for wiring, what is the volume of the solid part?
questions.solution:
⇒ Volume of prism = 45 × 14 = 630 cm3

⇒ Hollowed-out volume = 630 × (10 ÷ 100) = 63 cm3

⇒ Solid part volume = 630 − 63 = 567 cm3

questions.question: If secA + tanA = p, then what is secA in terms of p?
questions.questionHtml: If secA + tanA = p, then what is secA in terms of p?
questions.solution:
sec A + tan A = p.

(sec A + tan A)(sec A − tan A) = 1 ⇒ p(sec A − tan A) = 1.

sec A − tan A = 1 ÷ p ⇒ 2sec A = p + (1 ÷ p).

sec A = (p + (1 ÷ p)) ÷ 2 = (p2 + 1) ÷ (2p).

questions.question: A circular jogging track has a radius of 50 m. A runner covers a curved path that subtends an angle of 120° at the center. What is the length of the arc she runs?
questions.questionHtml: A circular jogging track has a radius of 50 m. A runner covers a curved path that subtends an angle of 120° at the center. What is the length of the arc she runs?
questions.solution:
Radius = 50, Central angle = 120º

Arc length = (120 ÷ 360) × 2π × 50

⇒ Arc length = (1 ÷ 3) × 100π = (100π ÷ 3)

questions.question: Which of the following is true for all acute angles A?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is true for all acute angles A?
questions.solution:
Let acute angle = A

sin A = cos(90º − A)

⇒ sin A = cos(90º − A)

questions.question: In a circle, angle subtended by chord AB at the center is 80°. What is the measure of angle ∠ACB, where C lies on the circle?
questions.questionHtml: In a circle, angle subtended by chord AB at the center is 80°. What is the measure of angle ∠ACB, where C lies on the circle?
questions.solution:
Angle subtended by chord AB at the center = 2 × ∠ACB

⇒ 80º = 2 × ∠ACB

⇒ ∠ACB = 80º ÷ 2 = 40º

questions.solution:
Angle at center = 2 × Angle at circumference

150 = 2 × Angle at circumference

Angle at circumference = 150 ÷ 2 = 75º
